meta.title: Stock quotes (watchlist / A-share / Hong Kong / US)
meta.description: A quote strip under the composer for A-share, Hong Kong and US securities: name, code, price, change, limit marks, a per-card source dot and a mini daily K-line, with search by code/name/pinyin, watchlist groups (including a seeded market group), drag reordering and hover removal. The detail panel adds intraday (1/3/5 days with volume and a percentage axis), 5/15/30/60-minute and daily/weekly/monthly/yearly charts (three adjust modes, moving averages, volume, crosshair), a five-level order book, A-share valuation fields, a position cost line, a trade ledger with realised P/L and price alerts, plus a plugin settings page. Two agent tools: stock_quote and stock_events (announcements / daily billboard). Quotes come from Tencent with Sina and Eastmoney fallbacks; mini charts are fetched separately and reused via ETag; polling follows each market's session and holiday state with exponential backoff. Display and bookkeeping only: no orders, no session or agent data.
